question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate verb:

The witness __________ under cross-examination, revealing inconsistencies in the testimony.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. faltered**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"faltered"** means to lose strength, confidence, or momentum, often hesitating or stumbling in speech or action. (डगमगाना, हिचकिचाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The speaker faltered briefly before continuing their speech.
 
 
• In the given sentence, "faltered" is appropriate because it describes how the witness hesitated or stumbled under cross-examination, revealing inconsistencies.
 
 
• **Example:** The witness faltered under cross-examination, revealing inconsistencies in the testimony.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. faltered**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Collapsed** (ढह जाना, गिर जाना): To fall down or give way suddenly, often due to pressure or loss of strength.
 
 
• **Example:** The bridge collapsed under the weight of the heavy truck.
 
 

 
• **Admitted** (स्वीकार करना): To confess or acknowledge something as true, often reluctantly.
 
 
• **Example:** She admitted to making a mistake during the project.
 
 

 
• **Insisted** (जोर देना): To demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.
 
 
• **Example:** He insisted on paying the bill, even though it was not necessary.
